sources.entry: Rallly - Create polls to vote on dates and times (alternative to Doodle). (Demo, Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Nodejs/Docker
Rallly | Schedule group meetings with polls

summary.one_liner: Rallly is an open-source scheduling tool for creating date and time polls so participants can vote on when they are available to meet.
summary.what_it_does: Rallly lets a user create a poll with several date/time options and share the link. Participants vote on their availability without needing an account. The poll shows an availability grid of everyone's responses, and participants can comment on the poll. The organizer can get notified as people respond, then finalize the winning date and notify everyone. The interface is translated into 10+ languages through Crowdin. It is available as a hosted cloud version or as a Docker image for self-hosting, and the README says it is built with Next.js, Prisma, tRPC and TailwindCSS.
use_cases: find a meeting time across participants
poll friends or team members on dates
how_to_run: Use the hosted cloud version at the project website (no installation)
Self-host by running the Docker image, following the self-hosting docs
See the contributing guide for local development setup
notable: Participants vote without creating an account
Availability grid shows all responses at a glance
Finalize a chosen date and notify participants
Community translations via Crowdin in 10+ languages
Ships as a Docker image for self-hosting
caveats: Self-hosting requires following separate docs for installation and configuration, which the README does not detail here
The hosted cloud version is offered as 'free' with no detail on limits in the README
